boundary_decisions.rationale: Experiment proposals, assignment/exposure state, metric cuts, stopping and conclusions form an independently adopted operated lifecycle distinct from causal-estimation libraries.
Forecast lifecycle, collaboration, overrides and publication are independently adopted above replaceable forecasting libraries.
An optimizer has independent adoption, licensing, APIs, numerical behavior, statuses, support and replaceability even when embedded in an application.
The adopted workbench/project lifecycle is distinct from PM4Py and OCEL as library and carrier, respectively.
A spatial project/workflow/history experience is independently adopted and composes standards, database extensions and algorithms without collapsing them.
Simulation model and experiment lifecycle, calibration, sensitivity, replications and interoperability form an independently adopted environment above simulation libraries.
Statistical analysis names a method universe served by libraries and hosted in notebooks, workbenches and applications; the label alone lacks one lifecycle, operation and adoption promise.
Causal identification and estimation remain method/library contracts; experiment assignment/exposure/lifecycle forms the product boundary.
Anomaly and change detection is a method imported by observability, quality, forecasting, security and vertical products; a detector name alone is not one user product.

Graph analysis as a method label remains a semantic/library family; the separately adjudicated Graph Analysis Workbench product owns workspace/run/publication lifecycle and does not absorb graph methods, persistence or vertical applications.
Text/document and media/signal names cover broad library method families; search, document workflow, vision inspection and signal-monitoring products must be adjudicated by their jobs and lifecycles.
A method contract may be implemented by a library and operated inside a product, but those identities, qualifications, failures and exits remain separate.

Models, LLMs and agents may implement typed assistance or explicitly required predictive capabilities, but deterministic contracts, evidence and authority remain mandatory and most products need no AI label.
Graph algorithms remain method/library contracts, but independent project/session/workspace, run, review, publication and exit lifecycles are adopted and operated as a workbench product.

ASCM defines a cross-functional enterprise operating-plan process, while SAP, Oracle and Pigment independently expose stable scenario/version, comparison, review, approval, publication and replanning lifecycles. These remain adoptable and replaceable above forecasting, optimization, simulation, workflow and execution suppliers.

ISO 21508 establishes cross-sector project/programme/portfolio applicability; GAO and DOE independently govern baseline, measurement and change lifecycles; Primavera independently operates the same first-class states. The lifecycle remains distinct from integrated planning, scheduling engines, finance, workflow, analytics and execution.

ownership.invariant: The estimand names population, variable, intervention/contrast where applicable and time scope before estimator selection.

Every finding names baseline, detector, threshold, cut and expected error behavior.
Every event/object/case projection names source occurrences, correlation, ordering, state derivation and known omissions.
